title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Front cover

A female of mud-dauber wasp (Sceliphron spp.) inserting a spiny orb-web spider (Micrathena schreibersi) in her nest in an Amazonian Rainforest fragment. The wasp was unable to fully insert the spider due to its abdominal spines blocking the nest opening. This record provides the first evidence of a potential defensive function of spiny orb-web spider spines. Photo by: César Favacho.
